title: v3.0.0
excerpt: 3.0.0 (2026-11-05) ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES Default Gemini Developer API version is now v1 (was v1beta ) ( 2d0f947 ) Clients targeting the Gemini Developer API now default to API version v1 instead of v1beta . No effect on Gemini Enterprise (Vertex AI) defaults: Clients with vertexai=True / enterprise=True are unaffected by this default change and continue to default to v1beta1 . Some model aliases are not available on v1 , notably: gemini-flash-latest , gemini-flash-lite-latest and gemini-pro-latest . They exist only on v1beta . To keep using them, use a specific model version, or switch back to v1beta as shown below. How to configure or restore the previous default via environment variable: Set GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION (works for both Gemini Developer API and Enterprise / Vertex AI clients when no version is set in code): # Restores the beta default ('v1beta' on Gemini Developer API, 'v1beta1' on Enterprise / Vertex AI) export GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION=beta # Or set an explicit API version string on either platform (e.g. 'v1', 'v1beta', 'v1beta1') export GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION=v1beta How to set the API version in code: Pass api_version in HttpOptions (takes precedence over GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION ): from google import genai from google . genai import types client = genai . Client ( http_options = types . HttpOptions ( api_version = 'v1beta' ) ) Default HTTP client is now httpx2 (was httpx ), and httpx is no longer installed by default ( 51285c8 ) httpx is no longer installed by
